title: Gridder synthesized three-melody cycle
scope: Complete written melody forms in a locally synthesized reduced arrangement: Boléro, then Szła dzieweczka with written repeats and alternate endings, then all ten bars of O mój rozmarynie. No recordings or sampled instruments.

sources.title: Szla dzieweczka, John Chambers ABC collection
sources.locator: First melody: full A section with first and second repeat endings and all 16 B bars; K:D, L:1/4, M:3/4
sources.use: Melody pitch, duration, ties, written repeat and alternate endings. The lead, parallel harmony, bass and percussion are a new synthesized reduction.

sources.title: Szła dzieweczka, Biblioteka Polskiej Piosenki
sources.use: Identifies the melody as traditional and associated with Silesia.

sources.title: O, mój rozmarynie, Biblioteka Polskiej Piosenki melody score
sources.locator: Page 1, all 10 bars of the vocal melody, C minor
sources.use: Complete 10-bar melody, including written rests and flats, transposed up 14 semitones into D minor and up an octave. Mia independently visually checked the notes and durations.

sources.title: O mój rozmarynie nuty literowe, Proste Nuty
sources.locator: First lyric-aligned phrase in D minor
sources.use: Independent note-letter check of the opening pitch sequence.

limits: One complete notated tune form for each folk song, not a rendition of every lyrical verse or a recording. Boléro is a reduced synthesized arrangement, not the full orchestration. Playback quality, recognition and natural device behavior require listening and physical-device checks.
